people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

people.name: Arabah
people.line: A desert region in the Jordan Valley and southward.

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Heth
people.line: Son of Canaan and ancestor of the Hittites.

people.name: Jebusites
people.line: Canaanite tribe inhabiting Jerusalem before David's conquest

people.name: Negeb
people.line: The southern region of Israel, a semi-arid area

people.name: Perizzites
people.line: Canaanite people group living in the land of Canaan

people.name: Shephelah
people.line: Lowland region between Judean hills and coastal plain

translations.web: in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
translations.bsb: the hill country, the foothills, the Arabah, the slopes, the wilderness, and the Negev—the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites):
translations.kjv: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
translations.asv: in the hill-country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
